_lane_retirement_note: nvfp4_cb removed 2026-09-02: the Gridbook codebook lane was retired (archive/gridbook_lane_2026-09-02/). This profile's CB declarations are deleted rather than left dangling -- a supported_lanes entry is a promise that a pinned runtime serves those bytes, and none does.
_tessera_lane_rationale: Declared 2026-09-02, on served evidence and on wiring that exists rather than on the lane being sanctioned. The wiring: Tessera's own exporter stacks exactly this profile's two fused groups (self_attn.qkv_proj <- q/k/v, mlp.gate_up_proj <- gate/up) into one blob per vLLM module, and its plan translator reads this repository's layer_config.json in the same spelling. The evidence: the 2026-09-02 allocated-vs-uniform serve built Qwen3-0.6B Tessera checkpoints from a PrismaQuant allocation and served them on the plugin (docs/measurements/tessera-allocated-served-2026-09-02.md in the Tessera repository). This profile also claims Qwen3MoeForCausalLM, and Tessera's packaged contract declares structures: ["dense"] with no routed_moe cell -- so the container arm refuses a model with routed experts by reading that field, and the exporter refuses a planned expert by name. Declaring the lane here is NOT permission to build one: admission is fail-closed until the Tessera serving pin names a reviewed release (RobTand/tessera#17).
